name: controls
summary: The DEFAULT plugin UI (doc 37 tier-1): declare params once as a UI tree (tabs/sections of sliders/numpads/toggles/dropdowns/buttons/readouts) and get get_def/set_def/$schema/thread-safe access. Parasitic — a plain host member, no owner identity, no ABI surface.

native.delivery: header — a host member; host delegates get_def/set_def to it
native.status: IMPLEMENTED — test_controls (14 tests): schema tree emit, layout (tabs/grid/section/span/rows/caption), widgets (slider/numpad/stepper/range/toggle/dropdown/radio/text/file/color/button/readout/view/title/label/divider), semantic types, set_def clamp/enum-reject/absent-tolerant, snapshot typing + concurrency

ui.delivery: SOURCE (vanilla ES module) — like the native header, the consumer's build compiles/bundles it. The plet is a LEAF: this module imports nothing from the app layer; the app (extension/HMI/@xinsp2/components) depends on the PLET when it wants a schema panel.
ui.status: IMPLEMENTED — 6 tests (ui/mount-schema.test.mjs): tree/grid/tabs render, widget mapping + degrade intent, value seeding + set_instance_def wiring, button exchange, range two-key binding, null-when-no-$schema. Renders with the shared xi-* custom elements. Remaining: dedicated xi-stepper/xi-range/xi-color/xi-file elements, touch numpad, live-view mount into the view slot.

ui.note: SOURCE form — the webui build (vite/svelte) compiles these; the plet ships no artifact.

notes.zeroCore: Rides get_def/set_def/exchange only — no new transport, no cap, no ABI change (doc 37 additive invariant).
notes.schemaSource: Static plugin.json OR native get_def emit; both produce the same $schema tree. This helper is the native-emit path.
notes.state: values→def (persisted); structure→$schema (declaration, $rev-versioned); view state (open tab / collapse / scroll)→browser-local, NOT in def.
